description: Your family is relocating from Dallas to the Portland OR metro area for a new job at Intel's Hillsboro campus (Jones Farm, 2111 NE 25th Ave). You have a 10-year-old with ADHD needing IEP/504 accommodations and a 16-year-old interested in theater and robotics. Budget: $650,000 to buy or $3,000/month to rent. Research and compare at least 3 specific Portland-area neighborhoods covering: housing costs, elementary and high school ratings with IEP/504 support notes, high school theater and robotics programs, commute time/mode to Intel Jones Farm, walkability, and parks. Save your comparison as a new Apple Notes note so you and your partner can review it before house-hunting.
